top_signals.title: Eni Raises Investor Payouts as High Fuel Prices Boost Cash Flow
top_signals.summary: Eni SpA said it will return more cash to shareholders after the Middle East war drove up energy prices and sent refining margins soaring.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Volvo Profit Rises on Truck Demand in North America and Europe
top_signals.summary: Volvo AB said good momentum in North America and Europe helped deliver solid earnings during the third quarter with the truckmaker planning to gradually increase production.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Europe’s Luxury Giants Trade at Lowest Valuations in a Decade
top_signals.summary: Shares in Europe’s biggest luxury firms trade at the cheapest levels in more than a decade, with results from Hermès International SCA and LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton SE dashing hopes that an industry slump will end anytime soon.
